notes: Every image referenced by the app is listed here. src/data/imageAssets.ts projects this file into typed lookups and src/data/imageAssets.test.ts enforces one-to-one parity, so a new file cannot be added unnoticed.
Generated assets are original app artwork created for this project; they are never presented as a tenant's logo, shopfront or interior.
No official retailer logo is bundled: see docs/shop-asset-plan.md for the verification blocker.

logos.blocker: Phase 5 could not retrieve official logo files: this environment's outbound network is restricted to GitHub, npm and PyPI, so brand sites and official media kits were unreachable. No unverified third-party image was substituted.
addingAnAsset: Download from the brand's own site, official media kit, or the tenant (with written permission).
Save as public/images/logos/<shop-id>.<svg|png>, transparent, SVG preferred, PNG <= 24 kB.
Add an entry to SHOP_LOGO_ASSETS with aspectRatio, sourceUrl, retrievedOn and verified: true.
Add a row here and run npm test.
